subject: Kickoff: Evaluation & MAP for Redwood — Acme Health
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@acmehealth.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Evaluation & MAP for Redwood — Acme Health

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet you both on the call yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have aligned goals, owners, and a timeline for the evaluation and procurement phases. High-level items I propose we track in the MAP:

- Goals: validate latency & cost at your target throughput, confirm SSO/KMS integration approach, and evaluate model quality against your clinical prompt set
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 250ms (50-token gen), inference cost per 1k tokens under your target, and no critical security blockers
- Timeline: technical kickoff next week; evaluation complete + recommendation by Fri, 2026-03-26; procurement/PO by end of March (target close 2026-03-31)
- Owners: Customer champion "Samantha Wu" (exec sponsor), Redwood AE "Alex Martinez" (commercial owner), Redwood CS "Monica Patel" (technical owner), Procurement "Tom Reynolds" (customer procurement)

Could you confirm the owners above and whether the timeline works for you? If so I’ll share a draft MAP (roles, milestones, dependencies) and calendar options for a 60-minute technical kickoff next week.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Thanks Alex — this looks good.

Confirming I’ll be the customer champion and Tom will own procurement/PO. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Internal reviewers: Dr. Priya Shah (Clinical AI), Miguel Ortega (Infosec) — I’ve looped them into our internal thread (they’ll join the kickoff if relevant)
- Timeline: the proposed window through end of March is fine; ideally we land recommendation March 25 so our finance team can prioritize the PO the following week
- Constraints: Miguel will need a brief SOC2 + data-flow diagram before we run any test data into your environment

Please go ahead and share the MAP draft and a few times for next week (I prefer morning PST).

Awesome — thanks for the quick confirmation, Samantha.

I’ve attached a short MAP draft (MAP_v0.1.xlsx) and our Redwood evaluation checklist (redwood-eval-checklist.pdf) to this thread. The MAP includes a simple milestones table (kickoff, initial metrics run, security review, recommendation, PO). Action items I’ve prefilled:

- Alex: coordinate kickoff, share test harness and baseline config
- Monica: technical lead for evaluation (will drive agent-level tests and metrics)
- Samantha: executive signoff; coordinate clinical reviewers
- Tom: procurement timeline and PO approver

Monica — can you take point on the technical kickoff agenda and confirm what format of test data is easiest for you (sample JSON payloads vs. CSV)? Also please attach the quick checklist we use for SOC2 questions so Miguel gets what he needs.

Proposed kickoff slots (all PST):
- Thu 2026-02-19 09:30–10:30
- Thu 2026-02-19 11:00–12:00
- Fri 2026-02-20 08:30–09:30

If any of those work I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachment: MAP_v0.1.xlsx (draft) — see tab: milestones
Attachment: redwood-eval-checklist.pdf

Hi Samantha / Alex —

Thanks for including me. I’ll run the technical kickoff and own the evaluation runbook. Draft agenda (60 minutes):

1) Introductions and success criteria (10m)
2) Test harness & data format (15m) — we prefer JSON payloads; small sample set is fine to start
3) Security/data flow & SOC2 artifacts needed (10m)
4) Baseline config and performance targets (15m)
5) Next steps & owners (10m)

Samantha — for the SOC2 artifacts Miguel requested, I can share our SOC2 summary + a brief data-flow diagram. If he’s comfortable reviewing a redacted diagram that should be enough for the kickoff; we can follow up with any additional artifacts.

I’m available Thu 9:30–10:30 or 11:00–12:00. If you want, I can drop a calendar invite for Thu 9:30. Also adding a placeholder calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/j/monica-kickoff-acme
